meta.title: NearbyNinja — where to eat nearby: three places in seconds
meta.description: Hungry and not sure where to go? Send where you are and the Telegram bot shows three places you can walk into right now. Free, nothing to install.

hero.h1: Hungry and not sure where to go? Three places nearby — in seconds
hero.lead: Skip the hundreds of map pins and other people's reviews. Send where you are and the bot shows three places you can really walk into right now.
hero.cta_note: Free. Nothing to install and no sign-up — it all happens in Telegram.

steps.title: Send where you are
steps.text: Your location, a point on the map, an address or a Google Maps link — even for another city, in advance.

steps.title: Say what you want
steps.text: A café, restaurant or bar, how far you'll walk (from 100 m to a kilometre) and the rating you need. The bot remembers your choice.

steps.title: Get three places
steps.text: With distance and direction, and “Map” and “Share” buttons. All that is left is to choose.

pricing.title: What it costs
pricing.free_text: Search, cards and search inside a chat are available without payment.
pricing.paid_text: Searches with ratings and real photos: bonuses for daily visits, rewards for marking places and inviting friends, plus packs and Pro access for Telegram Stars.

items.q: What if the place turns out to be closed?
items.a: Tap “🚫 Closed” under the card. When two people mark it, the place disappears from the list for everyone. The data comes from open sources and can lag behind reality — that is why your marks help.

items.q: Why are there sometimes fewer than three places?
items.a: If few suitable places are close, the bot widens the search up to a kilometre. If there are still few, it shows what it found. Try another spot or the “everything” category.
Yes: search and cards are free. Extra features cost Telegram Stars and are optional.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Open the bot in Telegram and tap “Start”. No sign-up.

items.q: How do I search in another city or in advance?
items.a: Tap “🗺 Another point”: pick a place on the map via the paperclip, type an address or coordinates, or send a Google Maps link.

items.q: How do I search in a chat with friends?
items.a: Type @{bot} in any chat followed by, e.g., “cafe 1km” or an address. On a computer, send the bot your location once or add an address to the query.

items.q: What does the bot know about me?
items.a: It keeps your search point for a few hours at most. See the privacy policy for details.

items.q: Where does the place data come from?
items.a: From open maps and partner services (the sources are listed at the bottom of the page). It can be inaccurate — that is what the “🚫 Closed” button is for.
Use /paysupport in the bot, or /feedback with your payment ID. The terms are on the Terms of Use page.

guides.title: What to try: city guides
guides.lead: Hand-reviewed lists of local dishes and drinks.

p: The bot finds cafés, restaurants and bars near the spot you give and shows data from third-party sources. We do not guarantee its accuracy, freshness or the venues' opening hours.
Do not use the bot for automated data collection or to overload the service. We may restrict access in case of abuse.
For payment issues use the /paysupport command in the bot, or write via /feedback with your payment ID.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.note: A draft prepared by the project owner; it is not legal advice.

p: Your Telegram account ID and language; your search settings (radius, minimum rating, category).
The location or address you send for a search: it is used only for the search and kept for a few hours at most; the last point is kept for inline mode on desktop.
Your 👍/👎 votes and “closed” reports (place ID and your ID), referral links, limit and streak counters, Telegram Stars payment data (payment ID), and the text of your /feedback messages.

To run a search, the coordinates and address are sent to data providers: Geoapify, Foursquare, OpenStreetMap (Overpass, Nominatim) and, as a fallback, Mapbox. For some requests the coordinates are rounded to a cell of about 100 m.
Payments are processed by Telegram. We do not receive bank card data.

We keep aggregate usage statistics: request and feature counters without identifiers and, to count daily active users, the account ID in a set with a limited lifetime. These data are kept for 90 days.
You can request deletion of the data tied to your account via /feedback.

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.lead: What everyone looking for a bite runs into — and how the bot handles it.

items.pain: Hundreds of pins on the map, too much to choose from
items.fix: The bot shows three places instead of a hundred: the nearest and well rated. Easy to choose.

items.pain: You get there and it has closed for good
items.fix: We filter out closed places. Found one that no longer works? Tap “🚫 Closed” and it disappears from the list.

items.pain: A gym or a hotel instead of a café
items.fix: The bot only shows places where you can eat and drink.

items.pain: Almost nothing nearby, and searching further is a hassle
items.fix: If fewer than three places are close, the bot widens the search a little by itself and tells you.

items.pain: New city, no idea what to try
items.fix: The “What to try here” card: local dishes and how to eat them. One button and the bot finds places serving the dish nearby.

items.pain: Want to invite friends, not forward screenshots
items.fix: Find a place right in the conversation — type @{bot} — and send it to your friends in one tap.
Nothing to install: the bot works inside Telegram, in Russian, English and Chinese.

items.pain: No ratings, so no way to know if it's worth it
items.fix: Guests mark places 👍/👎, and places without ratings get a community rating 🥷.
